card.name: Start of L/C words about lungs and airways
card.fires_on: The first letter or opening piece of a medical word beginning with L or C (Lactic, Laryngospasm, Lactation, Colds, Mucocutaneous), often at the start of a new sentence or heading. The word is cut off after its first piece.

modes.label: Sentence-initial L
modes.description: A capital L that begins a sentence and starts a word like Lactic, Laryngospasm or Lactation.

modes.label: Partway through other words
modes.description: The opening or middle piece of a longer medical term, such as Cholinergic or mucocutaneous.

card.writes: It pushes toward lung and chest words such as lung, chest and Thor, which suggests a respiratory or thoracic word is expected.
card.plain: It fires on the first letter of medical words like lactic or laryngospasm, where the model is still working out which word it is.
